# Inflatable Pool Factory

> Inflatable Pool Factory designs and supplies premium drop stitch inflatable swimming pools — rectangular and round models with rigid, rock-solid walls that set up in minutes and fold away for winter storage.

Inflatable Pool Factory pools are built with drop stitch construction: thousands of internal threads lock the top and bottom PVC panels together, so the walls inflate rock-solid at high pressure and behave like a rigid above-ground pool. Every pool is 100% pressure-tested before shipping and complies with EN 16582-1 and ASTM F2666 safety standards. Contact: info@inflatablepoolfactory.com.
